needs_human.note: A downward pull of 12px or more from the handle reveals the header. The approved spec names only a tap (129 step 4). decisions.md records the human's choice, but the spec and the invariants do not.; Because of pointer capture, a press on the handle that drifts sideways or upward and is then released can still produce a click on the handle and reveal the header with a mouse on a hybrid device. With touch, a move beyond the tap slop produces no click, so the drift does nothing.
The downward pull reveal (AppShell.tsx:88-97, threshold 12px) is not in the spec text. Only decisions.md records it.
